name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his compulsory military service, where he was assigned to maintain transport vehicles. His meticulous nature and uncanny ability to diagnose and repair complex composite structures caught the attention of a local racing team owner. After his service, he apprenticed at a small composite fabrication shop, honing his skills in carbon fiber and other advanced materials. He now brings a pragmatic and detail-oriented approach to ALL-INKL.COM Münnich Motorsport, where he is responsible for the structural integrity of the team's racing vehicles.

Zoltán approaches every repair and fabrication with a methodical precision, always seeking the most efficient and reliable solution. His dedication to perfection means that no detail is overlooked, ensuring the safety and performance of the cars. He is known for his ability to work under pressure and his unwavering commitment to quality, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.description: A lean man with a serious demeanor and focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an exact point before starting any task.
Insists on using a specific type of Hungarian-made adhesive tape for all repairs.
Meticulously cleans his workspace at the end of each day, regardless of how busy he is.
